photos.desc: This series of shots come from the Melbourne Aquarium - it was really great - recommend it to all. Difficult to shoot through perspex but some of these are worth sharing. I shot this looking up into a
Turtle and remora swim through a group of bannerfish in Thailand.

photos.file: Angelfish, Popok Bayi dan Koral di Malalayang Bay, Manado.jpg
photos.desc: Kawasan bawah laut Malalayang Kota Manado memiliki taman laut yang sehat. Sayangnya, sampah milik manusia mulai mengancam, sampah popok bayi adalah salah satunya selain sampah plastik dan ban bekas.
